name: surtr
description: Read-only hardware monitor: CPU, GPU and memory details, live sensors, GPU throttle reasons and history.
long_description: Lets the assistant ask about this machine's hardware: what is installed, what the sensors read now and over the last hours, and why a GPU is slower than it should be. Every tool is read-only. See https://github.com/surtrhq/surtr/blob/main/docs/mcp.md.
